read.thesis: Record Q1 CY26 revenue of $20.6B and ROTCE 27.1% on Markets and IB strength, with expense efficiency at 65% and $1.75B buybacks; no capacity or supply metrics apply to this bank.

triggers.label: Record revenue $20.6B, up 16%
triggers.quote: Morgan Stanley reported a record quarter. Strong execution resulted in net revenues of $20.6 billion, EPS of $3.43 and a ROTCE of 27.1%.

triggers.label: Net new assets $118B in Wealth
triggers.quote: net new assets of $118 billion and fee-based asset flows of $54 billion

red_flags.label: Severance $178M from March workforce action
red_flags.quote: we recognized severance costs of $178 million in Compensation and benefits expense
